about.heroTitle: DingQi tools with clean WhatsApp ordering
about.heroCopy: DINGQI GROS is a modern ordering experience for DingQi tool customers in Morocco. The catalog uses local product data and simple forms that send customer requests directly to WhatsApp.
about.value.presentation.title: Premium presentation
about.value.presentation.text: A bright orange and gray brand system gives professional tools a clean industrial showroom feel.
about.value.catalog.title: Traceable catalog
about.value.catalog.text: Each imported product keeps its product ID, specifications, images, category, and DingQi source URL.
about.value.trade.title: Trade ready
about.value.trade.text: Search, filters, product details, quantity controls, cart, and checkout are tuned for practical sourcing.
about.value.pricing.title: Manual pricing
about.value.pricing.text: Prices are confirmed manually so every quote can match availability and quantity.
about.model.title: A storefront built around clear requests before confirmation
about.model.p1: The importer reads product sources, downloads product images locally, and writes a clean JSON catalog. The frontend renders that data across the home page, shop, categories, product details, cart, and checkout.
about.model.p2: Customers send only their name, phone number, and city through the form. Product or cart details are added automatically when the request comes from an order flow.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.info.title: Information we collect
privacy.info.text: DINGQI GROS collects the information customers provide through forms and WhatsApp messages, including name, phone number, city, and selected products.
privacy.use.title: How information is used
privacy.use.text: Customer information is used to prepare quotes, confirm product availability, arrange delivery, answer support questions, and keep a record of order requests.
privacy.catalog.title: Product and analytics data
privacy.catalog.text: The product catalog is stored locally and contains DingQi product names, IDs, categories, images, specifications, and source URLs. Analytics can be connected after deployment if the store owner chooses to do so.
privacy.sharing.title: Sharing and retention
privacy.sharing.text: Customer details are not sold. Information may be shared only with service providers needed to fulfill orders, such as delivery partners or communication tools.
privacy.rights.title: Customer rights
privacy.rights.text: Customers can request correction or deletion of their submitted information by contacting DINGQI GROS through the contact page or WhatsApp.
terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.quote.title: Quote-based ordering
terms.quote.text: DINGQI GROS displays products for reservation and quote requests. A submitted cart or checkout message is a request, not an automatic purchase contract.
terms.product.title: Product information
terms.product.text: Product names, categories, images, descriptions, product IDs, and specifications come from DingQi product sources. DINGQI GROS may update or correct catalog data when source information changes.
terms.confirm.title: Availability and confirmation
terms.confirm.text: Availability, delivery timing, final pricing, and order acceptance are confirmed manually after the customer submits a request through WhatsApp or the checkout form.
terms.customer.title: Customer responsibilities
terms.customer.text: Customers are responsible for providing accurate name, phone number, city, quantities, and model requirements. Incorrect information may delay quote preparation or delivery.
terms.support.title: Returns and support
terms.support.text: Return, exchange, warranty, and support terms should be confirmed during the quote process because professional tools may be subject to supplier conditions and product-specific policies.
